comparison.objective: Register a windowed plate behind an inspection screen despite grasp-induced visual occlusion.
comparison.physical_skill: View planning, memory or regrasp, and precise released planar registration.
comparison.success_condition: Released, supported, stable registration within 3 mm for full credit or 12 mm for partial; detailed damage constraints are not given in the body.
comparison.reason: It tests perception-conditioned placement under occlusion, with no impact, manufactured-notch fracture, retained insert, or fragment-containment outcome.
